question: Where were the 2025 Asian Athletics Championships held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Korea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **26th** edition of the **Asian Athletics Championships** is scheduled to be held in **Gumi**, **South Korea**, in **2025**.
 
• The decision to award the hosting rights to **Gumi** was made by the **Asian Athletics Association** (**AAA**) during its council meeting held in **2023**.
 
• **South Korea** will be hosting this prestigious continental event for the **third** time, having previously organized it in **Seoul** in **1975** and **Incheon** in **2005**.
 
• The city of **Gumi**, located in the **Gyeongsangbuk-do** province, won the bid against **Xiamen**, **China**, which was also a strong contender for the **2025** event.
